name: token-saver
description: Five explicit workflows that reduce avoidable coding-agent context.

interface.shortDescription: Reduce noisy context before it reaches the model.
interface.longDescription: Audit context overhead, filter command failures, inspect focused diffs, create session handoffs, and retrieve narrow documentation slices.
defaultPrompt: Use $token-audit to find avoidable context costs.
Use $errors-only to run tests without dumping logs.
Use $diff-context to review only changed code.
